Class NetworkService

java.lang.Object
SocialNetwork.service.NetworkService
public class NetworkService extends Object
Service responsible for managing social network business logic using Java 8 Stream API: adding/removing users, establishing/removing friendships, and retrieving network-related statistics without imperative loops.

  • Method Details

    • addUser

      public Utilizator addUser(Utilizator utilizator)
      Adds a new user to the system. If the user does not have an ID set, one is automatically generated incrementally. Checks for duplicates using Stream.anyMatch(Predicate).
      Parameters:
      utilizator - the user to add
      Returns:
      the added user
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the user is null, a user with the same full name exists, or a user with the same ID already exists

    • removeUser

      public void removeUser(Long id)
      Removes a user from the network by their ID, automatically deleting all friendships in which they were involved using Stream API.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the user to remove
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the user is not found or the ID is null
